about: What the real Telegram made of numeric HTML entities: Bot API 10.4, 2026-11-16, issue #174 (sendRichMessage to a test group through /api/raw, each message deleted right away). In html text and attributes; in markdown text the same, in a code fence entities stay as typed. tests/test_rich_limits.py checks spec/validator.py against it, tests/render_unit.mjs the preview (render.js). To be measured again with a new Bot API.
